title: Hot Smoky Mexican Beans Tacos
description: A delicious, comforting recipe featuring a rich, smoky flavor profile and a variety of textures, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.

ingredients.name: Dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
Canned chipotle peppers in adobo sauce

instructions: In a large saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chipotle peppers, smoked paprika, and five-spice powder, if using, and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the soaked and drained black beans, the adobo sauce, and 2 cups of water to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
While the beans are cooking, toast the tacos shells according to package instructions.
To assemble the tacos, spoon some of the bean mixture onto a warmed taco shell, followed by a sprinkle of shredded cheese, diced tomatoes, and any other desired toppings.
